title: [review] project-LICHEN-5pe7: TOCTOU race in _unused_tcp_port() helper
description: In python/tests/sim/test_renode_peripheral_models.py, _unused_tcp_port() (line 49-52) binds a socket to port 0, obtains the port number, then closes the socket (via context manager). Between close and Renode's bind, another process can grab the port. This is a classic TOCTOU race that can cause flaky test failures. Use SO_REUSEPORT or pass port 0 to Renode directly if supported.
